name: loopd
description: The OKF control panel as a Claude Code plugin: brief yourself (/brief-me), capture decisions (/capture), work a task in-session (/work), run the gated loop (/dispatch), hand projects over (/handoff) — plus three mods (usage, pane, signal), each a /config switch.

usage.title: Usage mod
usage.description: Record each session's tokens, requests, tool calls, tool errors, wall time and model in the plugin store under loopd.usage.<session id>; session-usage.sh reads it before the transcript. Off = the transcript is read as before.

pane.title: Pane mod
pane.description: Register /pane, which draws this bundle's board (or, in simple mode, an inbox of questions, stuck tasks and progress) in a pane beside the session. Off = the three core renderers are all there is.

paneMode.title: Pane mode
paneMode.description: operator draws the full board from the snapshot; simple draws only projects, open questions and blocked tasks, from the task documents.

signal.title: Signal mod
signal.description: A role agent's session tells the project-manager's session that its turn is over, the moment it is over, with one loopd-signal: line; step 4 settles that session first. Off = step 4 reads sessions exactly as before.
